decision.question: Post about running 5 companies with AI at 20?
decision.recommendation: The week of 2026-02-20/21 is a great snapshot: feasibility study for a drone company, investor outreach for a wellness startup, webinar prep for a personal brand, client reports for active businesses, AND fixing a distributed AI codebase. All in 48h. This is the OttoGen prodigy narrative.
evidence: 5 distinct projects got meaningful progress in 48h (SentinAgro, ZenithCred, OttoGen, client reports, Chimera)
Investor outreach + VC research happening simultaneously with product work
20yo running this without a team — exactly the narrative that goes viral on LinkedIn

Monday: wrote a full feasibility study for an agricultural drone company. Tuesday: researched 20 venture capital firms, drafted investor emails. Wednesday: built a webinar outline, wrote LinkedIn outreach templates. Thursday: delivered quarterly reports across five companies. Friday: debugged our AI engine — 315 tests, all passing.
